examples.ko: 신문 나부랭이를 읽을 시간에 공부나 해요.
examples.en: Instead of reading some scrap of a newspaper, go study.

examples.ko: 그런 잡지 나부랭이 같은 건 버려요.
examples.en: Throw away junk like those cheap magazines.
The desk is covered with scraps of paper.

examples.ko: 돈 나부랭이 좀 있다고 잘난 척하지 마요.
examples.en: Don't show off just because you have a bit of money.

examples.ko: 그 사람이 쓴 건 글 나부랭이일 뿐이에요.
examples.en: What he wrote is nothing but a bit of scribbling.

examples.ko: 쓸 만한 건 없고 헝겊 나부랭이만 남아 있어요.
examples.en: There's nothing useful left, only scraps of cloth.

explain: '종이 나부랭이', '글 나부랭이'처럼 앞의 말에 붙여서 하찮은 것을 낮춰 부르는 말이에요. 말투가 거칠어서 일상에서는 투덜대거나 얕볼 때 써요. 사람에게 쓰면 아주 무례하게 들리니 조심하세요.

phrases.example: 책상 위에 종이 나부랭이만 잔뜩 쌓여 있어요.
phrases.en: The desk is piled with nothing but scraps of paper.
phrases.nuance_ko: 쓸모없어 보이는 종이를 낮춰 부르는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing that belittles paper as worthless scraps.

phrases.example: 글 나부랭이 몇 줄 쓴다고 작가가 되는 건 아니에요.
phrases.en: Writing a few lines of scribble doesn't make you a writer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 잘 쓰지 못한 글을 낮춰 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to belittle poor writing.

phrases.en: I threw away all the worthless old magazines.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 명사를 붙여 그 물건을 하찮게 여기는 마음을 나타내요.
phrases.nuance_en: Placed after a noun, it shows contempt for that thing.

explain_en: It attaches to a preceding noun, as in '종이 나부랭이' (scraps of paper) and '글 나부랭이' (bits of writing), to put down something as trivial. The tone is rough, so it is used when grumbling or looking down on something. Using it about a person sounds very rude, so be careful.

examples.en: I used olive oil as a substitute for butter.
This is not the real thing; it is a substitute.

examples.ko: 설탕 대용품을 사 봤는데 맛이 달라요.
examples.en: I tried a sugar substitute, but the taste is different.

examples.ko: 급할 때 쓸 대용품이 하나 있으면 좋아요.
examples.en: It is good to have a substitute you can use in a hurry.
They say this powder is a milk substitute.

examples.ko: 비싼 걸 살 수 없으면 대용품이라도 쓸 만해요.
examples.en: If you can't buy the expensive one, even a substitute is good enough.

explain: 원래 쓰려던 물건 대신 쓰는 물건이에요. '버터 대용품'처럼 '무엇의 대용품' 형태로 말해요. 진짜보다 조금 못하다는 느낌이 있어서 '대체품'보다 아쉬운 뉘앙스가 날 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I had no milk, so I used soy milk as a substitute.
phrases.nuance_ko: 원래 물건이 없을 때 대신 쓴다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: It means using something in place of the original.

phrases.en: I'm looking for a replacement for this product.
phrases.nuance_ko: '대용품'보다 아쉬운 느낌이 덜한 중립적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A more neutral word with less of a 'second-best' feel.

phrases.en: I use a sugar substitute to cut down on sugar.
phrases.nuance_ko: '무엇의 대용품' 형태로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: It follows the pattern 'a substitute for X'.

explain_en: It is a thing used in place of what you originally meant to use, in the form '무엇의 대용품' like '버터 대용품'. It can carry a slight feeling of being a bit inferior to the real thing, so it may sound more disappointing than '대체품'.

examples.en: I used a worm as bait when fishing.
The fish took the bait and ran away.
The low price in that ad is just a lure.
Be careful not to fall for the bait.

examples.ko: 아버지는 낚시 가게에서 새 미끼를 샀어요.
examples.en: My father bought new bait at the fishing shop.

examples.ko: 공짜 선물이라는 미끼 뒤에 비싼 계약이 있었어요.
examples.en: Behind the bait of a free gift was an expensive contract.

explain: '미끼'는 낚시에서 물고기를 잡으려고 끼우는 먹이예요. 사람을 속여 끌어들이는 것도 '미끼'라고 하고, 그때는 '미끼를 던지다', '미끼에 걸리다'처럼 말해요. 같은 비유를 쓰는 '낚시'도 인터넷에서 속이는 글을 말할 때 써요.

phrases.example: 그 회사는 싼 가격으로 미끼를 던졌어요.
phrases.en: throw out bait
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람을 끌어들이려고 이익을 보여 주는 것을 말해요. 낚시의 미끼에서 온 비유예요.
phrases.nuance_en: Showing a benefit to draw people in, a metaphor from fishing bait.

explain_en: 미끼 is the food you put on a hook to catch fish. Anything used to trick people into joining is also a 미끼, as in 미끼를 던지다 and 미끼에 걸리다. The word 낚시 is used on the internet for deceptive posts in the same way.

examples.ko: 피부는 몸을 지키는 보호막 역할을 해요.
examples.en: Skin acts as a protective layer for the body.

examples.ko: 게임 캐릭터가 보호막을 켜서 공격을 막았어요.
examples.en: The game character turned on a shield and blocked the attack.
Tears are a thin protective layer for the eyes.

examples.ko: 공기층이 추위를 막는 보호막이 되어 줘요.
examples.en: The layer of air acts as a shield against the cold.

examples.ko: 부모님이 만들어 준 보호막 안에서만 살 수는 없어요.
examples.en: You cannot live only inside the shield your parents made for you.
The ozone layer is called the Earth's protective shield.

explain: 보호막은 무언가를 지키는 얇은 층이에요. 눈물이나 피부처럼 눈에 보이는 것에도, 오존층이나 '부모님의 보호막'처럼 눈에 안 보이는 것에도 써요. 게임에서 공격을 막는 효과도 보호막이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The body puts up a shield to block viruses.
phrases.nuance_ko: 막아 주는 층을 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means to set up a layer that blocks harm.

phrases.en: My parents are a strong shield for me.
phrases.nuance_ko: 눈에 안 보이는 도움이나 안전을 비유할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative use for unseen help or safety.

phrases.en: Lotion makes a protective layer on the skin.
phrases.nuance_ko: 얇은 층으로 지킨다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means protecting with a thin layer.

explain_en: 보호막 is a thin layer that guards something. It works for visible things like tears or skin, and for invisible things like the ozone layer or '부모님의 보호막'. In games, an effect that blocks attacks is also called 보호막.

examples.en: The museum has a replica instead of the real one.
This painting is a reproduction, but it looks really similar.
I decided not to buy a knockoff bag.
A replica is much cheaper than the original.
The souvenir shop sells replicas of relics.
Please check whether this watch is a copy.

explain: 원래 것은 '원본'이나 '진품'이라고 해요. '복제품'은 똑같이 만든 것이라 박물관 유물 복제처럼 좋은 뜻으로도, 가짜 명품처럼 나쁜 뜻으로도 쓰여요. 나쁜 뜻은 '짝퉁'이라고도 하지만 짝퉁은 편한 말투예요.

phrases.en: The museum made a replica of the artifact.
phrases.nuance_ko: 원래 것을 똑같이 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means to make an exact copy of the original.

phrases.en: This is not a replica, it's the real thing.
phrases.nuance_ko: '복제품'과 반대로 진짜인 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The opposite of 복제품: the genuine item.

phrases.en: That bag was a knockoff.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가짜 명품을 가리키는 편한 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A casual word for a fake designer item.

explain_en: The original is a '원본' or '진품'. A '복제품' is a faithful copy, used positively for museum replicas and negatively for fake luxury goods. For the negative sense people also say '짝퉁', but that is casual.

examples.en: My grandmother is wearing a jade ring.

examples.ko: 비취 목걸이를 선물로 받아서 정말 기뻤어요.
examples.en: I was really happy to get a jade necklace as a gift.

examples.ko: 이 가게에서는 비취로 만든 장신구를 팔아요.
examples.en: This shop sells accessories made of jade.

examples.ko: 박물관에서 천 년 전 비취 조각품을 봤어요.
examples.en: I saw a thousand-year-old jade carving at the museum.
They say the deeper the green, the more expensive jade is.

examples.ko: 어머니는 비취 팔찌를 오래 아껴 오셨어요.
examples.en: My mother has treasured her jade bracelet for a long time.

explain: '옥'은 더 넓게 쓰는 말이고, '비취'는 특히 맑은 초록빛이 도는 옥을 말할 때 자주 써요. 반지, 목걸이, 팔찌 같은 장신구 이야기에서 많이 나오고, 이 보석 같은 푸른 초록색은 '비취색'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The sea sparkles in jade green.
phrases.nuance_ko: '비취'가 보석이라면 '비취색'은 그 보석 같은 맑은 초록빛을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: While 비취 is the stone, 비취색 is the clear green color of it.

phrases.en: My mother is wearing a jade bracelet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장신구 이름 앞에 '비취'를 붙여 어떤 보석인지 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put 비취 before an accessory name to say what stone it is made of.

phrases.en: This ring is made of jade.
phrases.nuance_ko: '옥'은 더 넓게 쓰는 말이고, '비취'는 그중 초록빛 옥을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 옥 is the broader word; 비취 is the green kind of it.

explain_en: '옥' is the broader word for jade, while '비취' is often used for the clear green kind. It comes up mostly when talking about jewelry such as rings, necklaces and bracelets, and the bluish green of the stone is called '비취색'.

en: pain in the neck; source of anxiety; cause of trouble

examples.ko: 쓰지 않는 피아노가 이젠 애물단지가 됐어요.
examples.en: The piano we don't use has now become a burden.
The youngest son is the family's troublemaker.

examples.ko: 인기 없는 신제품이 회사의 애물단지가 됐어요.
examples.en: The unpopular new product has become a headache for the company.
A big sofa is a nuisance in a small house.

examples.ko: 그 낡은 차는 팔지도 못하는 애물단지 신세예요.
examples.en: That old car is a white elephant that I can't even sell.
Land that was once a source of pride has turned into a burden.

explain: '골칫거리'와 비슷하지만, 버리거나 없애기도 마땅치 않은 물건이나 일에 자주 써요. 사람에게 쓰면 무례하게 들릴 수 있어요.

phrases.en: The parking problem is the neighborhood's headache.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻이 비슷하고 더 널리 쓰이는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar in meaning and more widely used.

phrases.example: 그 차는 집안에서 애물단지 취급을 받아요.
phrases.en: That car is treated as a burden in our household.
phrases.nuance_ko: 쓸모가 줄어든 물건이나 사람을 귀찮게 대하는 상황이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes something or someone treated as a bother.
phrases.en_equiv: to be treated as a burden

phrases.en: The expensive machine I bought just stayed a white elephant.
phrases.nuance_ko: 버리기도 쓰기도 곤란한 상태가 이어질 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something is awkward to use or discard and stays that way.

explain_en: It is similar to '골칫거리' (a headache), but is often used for things you can't easily throw away or get rid of. Using it about a person can sound rude.

examples.ko: 이 가게는 가공하지 않은 원석도 팔아요.
examples.en: This shop also sells unprocessed raw stones.

examples.ko: 원석을 잘 다듬으면 반짝이는 보석이 돼요.
examples.en: If you polish a raw stone well, it becomes a sparkling gem.

examples.ko: 원석 가격은 크기와 품질에 따라 달라요.
examples.en: The price of raw stones varies depending on size and quality.

examples.ko: 그는 아직 원석이지만 가능성이 큰 신인이에요.
examples.en: He's still a rough gem, but a rookie with great potential.
The raw stones dug up at the mine are sent to the factory.

examples.ko: 원석 그대로의 거친 느낌이 오히려 마음에 들어요.
examples.en: I actually like the rough feel of the stone as it is.

explain: 다듬기 전의 보석을 말하는데, 가능성이 있지만 아직 다듬어지지 않은 사람을 '원석'이라고 비유하기도 해요. 금속을 캐는 돌은 '광석'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The craftsman shaped the raw gemstone and made a ring.
phrases.nuance_ko: '원석'과 가장 자주 함께 쓰는 짝말이고, 사람을 키운다는 비유로도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common phrase with 원석; also used figuratively for developing a person.

phrases.example: 그 신인 배우는 아직 알려지지 않은 숨은 원석이에요.
phrases.en: That new actor is a hidden gem who isn't well known yet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아직 모르지만 가능성이 큰 사람을 비유할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figure of speech for someone with great potential who is not yet known.

phrases.en: I saw a large uncut diamond at the museum.
phrases.nuance_ko: 보석 이름 뒤에 붙여 다듬기 전의 그 보석을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Attach it after a gem's name to mean the uncut version.

explain_en: It refers to a gem before it has been cut or polished, and people also call someone with potential who is not yet polished a '원석' as a metaphor. Stone mined for metal is called '광석'.

examples.en: I saw a bronze sword at the museum.
People farmed in the Bronze Age.

examples.ko: 이 청동기는 삼천 년 전에 만들어졌어요.
examples.en: This bronze piece was made three thousand years ago.
A bronze artifact was found underground.
We learned about the Bronze Age in history class.
The mirror made of bronze is amazing.

explain: '청동기 시대'라는 역사 용어로 가장 많이 써요. 한국사 수업에서는 '구석기', '신석기', '청동기', '철기' 순서로 배워요.

phrases.en: In the Bronze Age, villages grew larger.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 많이 쓰는 역사 용어예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common history term using this word.

phrases.en: I looked at Bronze Age relics at the museum.
phrases.nuance_ko: 박물관이나 발굴 뉴스에서 자주 들려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often heard at museums and in excavation news.

phrases.en: A bronze sword is a very old object.
phrases.nuance_ko: 청동으로 만든 도구나 무기를 구체적으로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to name a specific tool or weapon made of bronze.

explain_en: It is used most often in the history term 청동기 시대 (Bronze Age). In Korean history class you learn the order 구석기, 신석기, 청동기, 철기.

examples.en: I made a toy out of scrap materials.
I put out all the junk piled up at home at once.
A scrap-collecting truck is passing through the alley.
Grandfather collects scrap and sells it.
We had a recycling class using scrap at school.

examples.ko: 이 가방은 폐품을 다시 쓴 제품이에요.
examples.en: This bag is a product made from reused scrap.

explain: 못 쓰게 되어 버린 물건이지만 다시 쓰거나 팔 수 있는 것들이에요. 그냥 '쓰레기'보다는 재활용을 생각한 말이에요. '폐품 재활용', '폐품 수거'처럼 자주 써요.

phrases.en: Our apartment complex collects scrap every Sunday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 모아서 가져가는 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the collection of scrap items.

phrases.en: I made a flower pot by recycling scrap.
phrases.nuance_ko: 다시 쓸 수 있다는 점을 보여 주는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing, showing the reuse idea.

phrases.en: My grandmother collects scrap and sells it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 팔거나 쓰려고 모을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when gathering scrap to sell or reuse.

explain_en: These are discarded things that can still be reused or sold. Unlike plain '쓰레기' (trash), the word has recycling in mind. Common phrases are '폐품 재활용' and '폐품 수거'.
